001: Excuse me, is the train station near here?
Yes, it's about a ten-minute walk. You have to go straight ahead.
And do I have to cross any major street?
Yes, you cross the main square and keep going until the end.
Okay, and is the main entrance on that street?
Exactly, you'll see it right across from the newsstand.
002: Hi, I'm looking for the museum of modern art.
Oh, it's in the center. You can take the subway, it's faster.
Which line do I have to take?
The green line, and you get off at the city hall stop.
And from there, can you see the museum?
Yes, when you exit, turn left and it's right in front of you.
003: Excuse me, do you know where the nearest pharmacy is?
Sure, there's one two streets from here, next to the supermarket.
Is it better to walk or take the bus?
Walking is better, it's only five minutes.
Perfect, thank you so much for the help.
You're welcome, have a nice day.
004: Hey, can you tell me how to get to the library?
Yes, of course. You leave here and turn right at the traffic light.
And then do I keep going straight?
Yes, until you see a small park. The library is across from it.
And is there any sign to recognize it?
Yes, it has a big blue sign.
005: Excuse me, does this street lead to the cathedral?
No, this one doesn't. You have to go back and take the second street on the left.
Oh, okay. And is it very far from there?
No, about a seven-minute walk, more or less.
Great, thanks for pointing it out to me.
No problem, it's easy to find.
006: Good morning, could you tell me where the central hotel is?
Good morning. It's on the main avenue, near the bank.
Can I get there by bus from here?
Yes, but I recommend walking, it's fifteen minutes.
And is the main avenue this same one?
No, it's the next one. Continue until the end of this street.
007: Hi, do you know if there's an ATM around here?
Yes, there's one at the gas station, just around the corner.
Is the gas station in that direction?
Yes, you turn at the corner of the bank and you'll see it right away.
You're welcome, I hope you find it without any problem.
008: Excuse me, is Retiro Park far from here?
No, not at all. It's about a twenty-minute walk.
And is there a bus that can take me there?
Yes, bus number five drops you off right at the entrance.
It's across the street, next to the stationery store.
009: Excuse me, I'm lost. How do I get to the bullring?
Don't worry, it's easy. From here you can see the clock tower, right?
Yes, I can see it in the distance.
Well, walk toward that tower and then turn right.
And is the plaza on that street?
Yes, at the end of the street you'll find it.
010: Hi, can you point me to where the central market is?
Sure, it's behind the city hall. You can go down this street.
Is it the street that comes out right next to the movie theater?
Yes, that very one. You go straight and then turn left.
And is the market in sight from there?
Yes, you'll see a big entrance with colorful awnings.
